goal: Deliver CGKN Repository Layout v1 without changing Artifact Runtime, Provider, packaging, or delivery behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Formal artifact, module, flow, policy, migration, and context-pack definitions load from specs/.
Raw artifacts, runs, generated output, live project memory, and historical iteration detail are not tracked in HEAD.
Before/after metrics, inventory, reference graph, branch report, cleanup plan, and curated Artifact Kernel evidence exist.
Artifact Kernel, kernel contract, repository hygiene, schema, and important legacy flow validation pass.
No Git history rewrite, force push, local runtime deletion, Provider-mainline change, or delivery-authority change occurs.

quality_metrics.method: repository hygiene guard and after metrics
reference scan, schema validation, and flow compilation

quality_metrics.measure: targeted cleanup, Artifact Kernel, and kernel contract tests

prevention: Generate inventory, reference graph, cleanup plan, and dry-run before applying moves or untracking.
assurance: Review changes against the kernel contract and confirm Provider and delivery mainline files are behaviorally unchanged.
control: Run schema, flow, Artifact Kernel, kernel contract, and repository hygiene checks.
improvement: Use curated evidence promotion and tracked-runtime guards for future runs.

interface_expectations: specs-first loaders preserve a warning-based legacy examples fallback
cleanup apply never deletes local runtime data
curated evidence has no release authority

feedback: Repository Layout v1 meets its scoped acceptance: specs-first registry, zero tracked raw runtime, curated evidence, compact current project management, passing flow/schema/kernel/hygiene checks, and no Provider or delivery-mainline behavior change.

The complete repository-wide test suite was not rerun; acceptance is bounded to the requested layout and directly affected contracts. Two ignored local cache directories remain as hygiene warnings only.

worked: Audit and dry-run exposed that artifacts alone accounted for most tracked files and bytes.
git rm --cached preserved local runtime data while reducing HEAD to source, specs, examples, curated evidence, and current governance.
A specs-first compatibility loader allowed formal registry migration without changing Artifact Runtime semantics.
did_not_work: Attempted local cache deletion was blocked by the host safety policy; the read-only guard now reports ignored local caches as warnings while continuing to fail tracked caches.
experiments: For the next evidence-producing run, use promote_evidence.py immediately and compare the curated bundle size with raw run size before any Git review.
